purpose: Development diagnosis of recorded v2 losses; inspected positions must not become held-out validation data

oracle.scoreSelection: Last unbounded info score (completed iteration estimate); retain the final reported line separately because a node limit can interrupt an aspiration search with a bound.
oracle.name: Stockfish 19

selection.stop: Analyze INTUITION moves chronologically within each completed loss. Stop at the first finite score regret >=200cp, newly allowed forced mate, or lost forced winning mate. Retain earlier rows.

caveats: Fixed-node Stockfish estimates can be unstable; restricted and unrestricted root searches can disagree.
This selects failures after observing outcomes, so it is development diagnosis, not independent strength evidence.
No Stockfish evaluation is used by the deployed playing engine.
All scores use the side-to-move perspective at the position before INTUITION chose its move. Mate scores are kept separate from centipawns.
